plain.li: [named] That's {NAME}, walking right past us.
Don't stare, it can tell when you stare.
I can feel it from here, like standing near a fire.
My hands won't stop shaking.
Nobody told me a god would be that tall.
I keep wanting to kneel and I don't know why.
It looked at me, I swear it looked right at me.
Everyone's gone quiet around it.
I'll be telling my grandchildren about this.
[night] It walks like it owns the night.
[storm] The air smells like rain before lightning.
[storm] Every hair on my arms is standing up.
[harvest] It smells like a field at harvest time.
[wild] It moves like a tree would, if a tree could walk.
[hunt] It moves like something that has never once missed.
[healing] Being near it is like the first warm day after a fever.
[war] I'd follow that into any fight.
[craft] Its hands look like they've made mountains.
[way] It looks like it has walked every road there is.
[dead] It's so cold near it, and so quiet.
[night] It's like looking at the moon up close.
[hearth] It feels like coming in from the cold.
[waters] It smells of the river after rain.
[machine] It moves too smoothly to be flesh.
[void] I can't look at its eyes for long.
Everyone stop, look over there.
Did you feel that?
The wind just died.
Look at the sky.
I've never seen the sky that color.
Something is here, something big.
Nobody move.
[appear,named] That's {NAME}, it has to be.
[appear] It's come, the old stories were true.
[reveal] The stranger, it was the stranger all along.
[reveal] It's growing, look at it grow.
[blessing] It's warm, the light is warm.
[blessing] Whatever we did, it was the right thing.
[wrath] What did we do to deserve this?
[wrath] Get inside, everyone get inside.
[wrath] It's angry, I can feel how angry it is.
[depart] It's leaving, I think it's leaving.
[depart] Will it come back?
[act] It's doing something, look.
[storm] That thunder came out of nowhere.
[dead] I heard a gong, did anyone else hear it?
[void] I can hear something whispering under everything.
[night] It's brighter than the moon.
[named] Watch over us, {NAME}.
[named] We are yours, {NAME}, we always were.
Thank you for coming to us.
I knew you would come, I always knew.
Forgive us whatever we did wrong.
Bless this place and everyone in it.
Whoever you are, be kind to us.
[harvest,named] Give us rain and a good harvest, {NAME}.
[storm,named] Spare our roofs, {NAME}, and send the rain.
[hunt,named] Give our hunters a straight aim, {NAME}.
[healing,named] Heal our sick, {NAME}, I beg you.
[war,named] Stand with us when the raiders come, {NAME}.
[craft,named] Guide our hands at the bench, {NAME}.
[way,named] Keep our travelers safe on the road, {NAME}.
[dead,named] Carry our dead gently, {NAME}.
[night,named] Send us good dreams, {NAME}.
[hearth,named] Keep our fires lit and our home warm, {NAME}.
[wild,named] Let the land grow green around us, {NAME}.
[waters,named] Keep the river kind to us, {NAME}.
[machine,named] We are listening, {NAME}.
[void] Take what you came for and leave us be.
There's something about that one I can't put my finger on.
Has anyone else noticed how quiet it gets around that one?
[!animal] That traveler stands too still, like nothing can hurry them.
[!animal] I don't think that's an ordinary traveler.
[!animal] They look at everything as if they've seen it all before.
[animal] That animal isn't afraid of anything, have you noticed?
[animal] That beast looks at us like it knows our names.
[night] The air shimmers around that one, look.
[night] There's a light about that one, I'm not imagining it.
[snow] It doesn't leave any footprints in the snow.
[snow] Look behind it, the snow isn't even pressed.
[animals] Every animal on the land keeps following that one.
[animals] Why do the animals follow it like that?
[psychic] My head rings like a bell when that one's near.
[psychic] Whatever that is, it's far bigger on the inside.
Did you see that?
That's a sign, if ever I saw one.
Something is coming, I can feel it.
I've got the strangest feeling all of a sudden.
Did anyone else hear that?
[storm] Thunder, out of nowhere.
[dead] I heard a bell from nowhere.
[wild] The leaves rustled, all of them at once.
[hunt] Was that a wolf?
[void] I heard someone sigh right behind me.
[night] Something glimmered over there.
[machine] Something hummed under the ground just now.
